facts: Clueso is a Y Combinator Winter 2023-backed startup founded in 2023 and based in Bengaluru (HSR Layout office); core team around 25 (YC profile); founders Akash Anand, Prajwal, and Neel Balar.

Product: turns screen recordings, slide decks, docs, or prompts into polished product videos plus step-by-step documentation, articles, and SOPs; AI handles script, voiceover, zoom effects, branding, and captions.
Raised a $10M Series A (site banner, October 2026).
Traction claims on their own site: over 1,000 SaaS companies use it; 300,000+ videos created in the past 6 months; #1 Product of the Month on Product Hunt; 4.9 rating on G2.

Enterprise customers shown on their site: Zendesk, Smartsheet, UiPath, ServiceTitan, RingCentral, Samsara, Zoho, GitLab, Fireflies.ai, Keyfactor, Perdue Farms, Total Quality Logistics, Gainsight, Seismic.
Clueso Agents automate the entire video production pipeline: a browser agent logs into the product, navigates workflows, screen-records features, then AI edits; every release can trigger new content.
Clueso MCP lets users build workflows in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or other AI clients to create and edit videos from their existing automations.
Localization across 150+ languages per site FAQ (site says both 80+ and 150+ on different pages - avoid the number).
Perks: catered meals (lunch and dinner except Sundays) and team offsites (last one in Vietnam).

Role: frontend-heavy full-stack ownership of the Articles/SOP rich-text editor (TipTap/ProseMirror), editor schemas, nodes, marks, plugins; AI-powered editing workflows (rewriting, expansion, auto-formatting, structured generation); templates and reusable content blocks; REST APIs, data models, backend collaboration; end-to-end product ownership with founders and designers.

Posting qualifications: 0-2 years or equivalent proof of work; strong React and frontend fundamentals; production web applications; open-source contributions valued; hands-on TipTap or ProseMirror sought.
